$comment: Body legality is expressed as a RULE MODEL plus an OVERRIDES table. The engine always consults
`overrides` first (exact match on position + heightInches) and falls back to the rule model.
When verified 2K27 numbers arrive you can either (a) tune the rule model params, or (b) paste a
full exact table into `overrides` and never touch the rule model again. Both are supported.

verification.notes: Invented. Replace with the shipped 2K27 weight sliders.
Invented. Replace with the shipped 2K27 wingspan sliders.

interactions.$comment: Rules that shrink one slider based on another. Empty by default: the engine treats an empty list as 'no known interaction', NOT as 'no interaction exists'.

verification.notes: No interaction rules are known for 2K27. If 2K27 restricts wingspan at extreme weights, add rules here.

overrides.$comment: Exact per-position, per-height legal ranges. Keys are `<POSITION>:<heightInches>`. Anything listed here wins over the rule models above. Ship verified data by filling this in.
